propositions: Repository-wide documentation, comments, and embedded prose require audit against operator standards effective 2026-08-20 covering punctuation rules, diction, formal voice, paragraph structure, and audience classification.

Three exploration shards (durable records, external documentation, developer comments) must inventory maintained surfaces with one owner per surface to prevent omission and overlapping review responsibility.

Evidence-based remediation proposals must cite repository paths, symbols, command output, ADRs, or tickets; every proposal must name target documentation type, audience, and remediation action with destination.

Maintained authored prose must be reviewed through canonical sources; mechanical validators risk false positives and are rejected; writing guidance applies to authoring without deterministic character enforcement.

Generated artifacts require typed ownership registry with generator-local descriptors exposing sources, outputs, update paths, verification paths, markers, cleanup, and lifecycle rather than one central repository-wide registry.

Foundation work (F01 documentation policy, F06 navigation, F07 index validation) and disposition of subsequent batch (F08-F49 remediation items) are complete under epic REB-3501; audit closure documented with operator ruling and session reference 8a036765705.
